dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, crenulated light-intensity perimeters. A prominent ring on the lower-left flank displays a jagged gradient transition from a light exterior boundary to a dark interior core. Smaller, similar circular perimeters are visible in the anterior-dorsal region near the neck.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A localized cluster of solid, high-intensity white pixels is present at the posterior-inferior margin of the primary annuli. Individual, scattered low-density high-intensity pixels are distributed along the mid-dorsal region, separate from the ringed structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the two primary flank annuli and the adjacent bright white blob form a scalene triangle. Centroids of three smaller, distinct circular structures on the upper neck form an approximately linear, equidistant chain.
